items.a: We're open Monday to Friday, 8:00am – 5:30pm, and Saturday 8:30am – 12:00 noon. We're closed on Sundays. See our Contact page for directions.

items.q: Do I need to book in advance?
items.a: We can often accommodate same-day bookings for MOTs and many repairs, but booking ahead means we can guarantee you a slot. Get in touch by phone or through our contact form and we'll find a time that suits you.
Yes — free estimates are always available. We're happy to take a look at your vehicle and give you honest, clear advice before any work begins.
We cover servicing and repairs, MOT testing, brakes, tyres, diagnostics, bodywork and accident repair, and detailing — see our Services pages for the full list.

items.q: Are you DVSA-authorised for MOT testing?
items.a: Yes. We're a DVSA-authorised test centre carrying out Class 4 and Class 7 MOT tests, with results submitted directly to the national MOT database.

items.q: Do you work on all makes and models?
items.a: Yes, we've been serving Northamptonshire since 1906, with experience across all makes and models — from everyday cars to classic and prestige vehicles. We're also an MG-approved body repairer, and have particular experience with Subaru and Mitsubishi models.
Yes, we're an approved repairer for major insurers and are also trusted by large fleet operators.

items.q: Will you tell me if something doesn't actually need doing?
items.a: Always. Honest advice is one of our core values — we'll tell you what genuinely needs attention and what can wait, with fair, transparent pricing throughout.

items.q: Do your used vehicles come with a warranty?
items.a: Every vehicle on our stocklist comes with a minimum six-month warranty, a full service and a fresh MOT included as standard. Full details are listed on each vehicle's page.

items.q: What payment methods do you accept?
items.a: We accept Visa, Mastercard and bank transfer. We do not offer finance.

items.q: Can I view a vehicle before deciding?
items.a: Of course — we'd encourage it. Get in touch via our Contact page or call us to arrange a time to come and view or test drive a vehicle from our stocklist.

items.q: What are my rights if something goes wrong?
items.a: As a UK consumer, you're protected by the Consumer Rights Act 2015 whether you're buying a vehicle or having work carried out. See our Consumer Rights page for a full plain-English summary.

items.q: How do you handle my personal data?
items.a: We only collect the information you give us — for example through our contact form — and use it to respond to your enquiry and provide our services. We don't use tracking or advertising cookies. See our Privacy Policy and Cookies Policy for full details.
